name: Karumaruka * Circle
source:
“You’re the master of this world!” With those words, Kaito was invited by his energetic turtle-toting underclassman Nicole to Seikai Academy’s student council room to join the star-crossing circle. All of the girls in that group are peculiar in their own way. Once every year, on the night of Tanabata, they gather to try to access ‘Karumaruka’. If they are successful, then they would be freed from their curses and their fear of the future.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
“你是这个世界的主人！”说完这句话，海斗就被精力充沛的背着海龟的学弟妮可邀请到了成海学园的学生会室，加入了跨星圈。该小组中的所有女孩都有自己的独特之处。每年一次，七夕之夜，他们都会聚集在一起，试图进入‘Karumaruka’。如果他们成功了，那么他们就会摆脱诅咒和对未来的恐惧。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
